body:
The changes to `get_bound_desired_size()` and most of `Label` are mostly okay; however, the removal of the checks for `!is_expanded_by_desired_size()` causes `Label` outside of a `Container` to no longer expand up to its maximum size. 
I don't think removing these checks is necessary based on your PR description, so why did you remove them? 

dev4:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/12f28272-41e9-4173-905f-eeaaa41094fb

PR:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f789c1c-7cbc-4fad-a2af-aa58e08d428f

Also, "Desired size is an intrinsic property and shouldn't be capped by dynamic parent layout caches." is an incorrect statement, as it includes the desired height, which is computed by the `Control` based on the width it is given; hence, it is dynamic and not intrinsic. Only the desired width is an intrinsic property.

In the current state, all callers of `get_bound_desired_size` rely on their own clamping of children's sizes based on their maximum sizes, so the change is acceptable.

In the future, when the desired size is separated into its basic components and exposed to users, the height component will need to be reverted to clamping based on the combined maximum size. This is a discussion beyond the scope of this PR though, so I will leave it at that.

LGTM!
The clanker's catch was also correct, missed that during my first review.
